title: Imp X
features:
🔥 **Fruit Battlegrounds - Major Rework Update!** 🔥

**Current Version: Rework (based on V1.5)**

**Main Changes:**
• Switched Panda Auth V2.5 → V3 🔒
• Switched Imp Hub UI Lib → Obsidian Lib (much smoother & modern UI) 🎨
• Full rework & optimization of the script's core features 🚀

**New Features & Improvements:**
🔹 **New Tab: Players ESP** 👀
   - Enable Players ESP
   - Show Name / Health / Fruit Level / Team
   - Health Bar
   - Tracer
   - Customizable Box
   - Editable Colors (Text, Outline, Box, Tracer, Health Bar)
   - Text Size: 14-24
   - Max Distance: 5000 studs

🔹 **Auto Use Skills** completely reworked (now supports WAY more skills) ⚔️
🔹 **Auto Farm** much faster & smarter (Bosses & Players) 🌾
   - Auto Farm Bosses now uses the same settings as Auto Farm Players
   - Dodge Hits (safe teleport during Auto Farm Players)
   - Auto Farm in empty zones (perfect for skills)
   - Auto Use Chop (Chop farming is insanely OP 🔥)

🔹 **Webhook Features Improved** 📊
   - Boss Kills Alert
   - Gems Increase Alert
   - Fruit Level Up Alert
   - Load Latest URL (no need to paste the webhook again)

🔹 **Other OP Additions:**
   + Bypass Chop Check (use skills with Chop without equipping it)
   + Safe Zone (manually add your safe spot)
   + Noclip ✈️
   + Infinite Jump 🦘
   + Set WalkSpeed & JumpPower
   + View Current FPS / MS

**+ Better overall QoL & Much More...** 💎

The script is stronger than ever, bro! Dominate Fruit Battlegrounds effortlessly. 😎
